phase: Phase S8: Default look for new editions
summary: All 47 targeted tests pass. F3 is fixed for same-folder creates. Two nonblocking gaps remain in rare temporary-name collisions and cross-folder concurrency.
nonblocking_findings: F4 [Nit] review-a: dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:246-251 does not reserve the temporary name exclusively. A forced timestamp/random collision lets one writer rename another writer's bytes, while the second write fails with ENOENT. Rationale: the in-memory probe reproduced this collision without real filesystem writes. Use exclusive temporary-file creation with collision retries.

F5 [Nit] review-a: dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:327-337, :372-374, and :402-404 check both series before creating a folder in only one series. Concurrent Primary and secondary creates can both succeed with the same id. Rationale: exclusive mkdir fixes same-folder contention but does not serialize id ownership across folders. A shared id reservation would enforce the global uniqueness rule.
